en: Let F be a number field with its field structure, E a Weierstrass curve over F with an ellipticity instance, Fbar a field equipped with an F-algebra structure (not assumed to be an algebraic closure), k₀ = ℚ(E.j) the intermediate field of F generated by E.j, and VBad an arbitrary set of finite places of k₀. An input P of type AdmissiblePrimeData consists of a natural number ℓ that is prime and at least 5; an additive-group isomorphism from the ℓ-annihilated subgroup of the affine points of E after base change to Fbar to (ℤ/ℓℤ)²; a group homomorphism ρ from the F-algebra automorphisms of Fbar to GL₂(ℤ/ℓℤ), whose matrix action in that basis agrees, for every automorphism and every ℓ-annihilated point, with applying the automorphism to the point; the inclusion of every determinant-one matrix in the image of ρ; openness of ker ρ; the assertions that F/k₀ is Galois and that its finite degree is coprime to ℓ; coprimality of ℓ and the characteristic of the residue field at each v ∈ VBad; and the following data for every finite place w of F lying over some v ∈ VBad (lying over means contraction of the corresponding ideal of integers): a unit q_w in the adic completion F_w with norm less than 1, the equality of the j-expression c₄³/Δ of its Tate Weierstrass curve with the image of E.j in F_w, and an element π_w ≠ 0 with norm less than 1 such that every unit x of F_w has norm ‖π_w‖ⁿ for some integer n, with ℓ coprime to the positive natural number obtained from a chosen integer n satisfying ‖q_w‖ = ‖π_w‖ⁿ. Here the Tate curve has coefficients (a₁,a₂,a₃,a₄,a₆) = (1,0,0,−5s₃,−(5s₃+7s₅)/12), where s_d = ∑′_{n∈ℕ} (n+1)^d q_w^(n+1)/(1−q_w^(n+1)); these are total infinite sums and field divisions. Write K for the intermediate fixed field of ker ρ inside Fbar. The datum P does not include the separate global-data predicate, nonemptiness of VBad, or an assertion that Fbar is algebraically closed. Let AG be a supplied AnabelianGeometry: for each field k in the universe it supplies a type O_k of “orbicurves”, types Cov(X,Y), composition of two such covers, operations B_f: O_k → O_L for every field homomorphism f: k → L and corresponding maps on covers, an object U(E) for each elliptic Weierstrass curve E/k, an operation M: O_k → O_k, profinite groups Π(X), and continuous open-embedding group homomorphisms Π(X) → Π(Y) for covers X → Y. It also supplies a bare predicate on four covers in a square, types Cusp(X), maps Cusp(X) → Cusp(B_f X), a bare predicate HasCore(X,C), bare predicates Tₗ(X) and T±ₗ(X) for every natural ℓ, types TS(X) for complete rank-one fields valued in the integers written multiplicatively with zero adjoined, a bare predicate Z±ₗ(X,s) for s ∈ TS(X), and bare types Rₗ(X) with maps Rₗ(X) → Cusp(X). Apart from the stated group-homomorphism, continuity and open-embedding requirements, no functor, identity, composition, quotient, core, Cartesian universal-property, torsion, or valuation-compatibility laws for these supplied objects are specified. The bundle defines CF=M(U(E)), X_K=B_{F→K}(U(E)) and C_K=B_{F→K}(CF), and defines a type of additional data: objects Cᵘ_K and Xᵘ_K with the supplied type predicates T±_ℓ and T_ℓ, the supplied relation HasCore(Cᵘ_K,C_K), covers Xᵘ_K→X_K→C_K and Xᵘ_K→Cᵘ_K→C_K satisfying only the supplied square predicate, a bijection R_ℓ(Cᵘ_K)≃ℤ/ℓℤ, a chosen element whose image under that bijection is nonzero, and a cusp equal to the function value associated with that element. revision_changes.new: For fields F,Fbar with an F-algebra structure on Fbar, a Weierstrass curve E/F, an intermediate field K of Fbar/F, and an F-algebra automorphism σ:K≃K, galK is the map from the represented affine points of E_K to themselves obtained by applying σ to point coordinates, with E_K the coefficient image of E under F → K. The map preserves zero and addition. Its displayed type uses the zero-and-addition structures on these points, without requiring E to be elliptic or either F or K to be a number field; it does not supply a separate proof of group laws. revision_changes.old: 设 F、Fbar 为域，Fbar 带有 F-代数结构，K 为 Fbar/F 的中间域且自身为数域，E 为 F 上的 Weierstrass 曲线。令 E_K 为 E 沿 F→K 的系数映射；对 K 的有限位 w，令 K_w 为在其对应极大理想处的进完备化，ι_w:K→K_w 为典范域嵌入，E_w 为 E_K 沿 ι_w 的系数映射。对 K 的 F-代数自同构 σ，记 G_σ 为它诱导的 E_K 上的加法点映射。它对有限位的作用记为 σw，其理想是 w 的理想在 σ⁻¹ 限制到 K 的整数环后所得映射下的逆像。 再设 F 为数域且 E 为椭圆曲线；令 k₀=ℚ(E.j)，VBad 为 k₀ 的有限位的任意集合，Bad(w) 表示存在 v∈VBad 使 w 在 v 之上，ℓ 为任意自然数，不要求是素数或正数。E_w 上的 TateStructure S_w 包含：K_w 中范数满足 ‖q_w‖<1 的单位 q_w；Weierstrass 变量变换 C_w，要求 C_w•E_w 等于系数为 (1,0,0,−5s₃,−(5s₃+7s₅)/12) 的曲线，其中 s_d=∑′_{n∈ℕ}(n+1)^d q_w^(n+1)/(1−q_w^(n+1))；以及从乘法商群 K_wˣ/⟨q_w⟩ 改用加法记号后到 E_w 仿射点群的加法群同构 φ_w。对每个对所有整数 n 都满足 q_wⁿu≠1 的单位 u，点 φ_w([u]) 的变换后坐标满足 x_C=X(u)、y_C=Y(u)；这里 x_C 在零点取 0，在表示为 (x,y) 的非零点取 (x−C_w.r)/(C_w.u)²；y_C 在零点取 0，在其他点取 (y−C_w.t−C_w.s(x−C_w.r))/(C_w.u)³；X(u)=∑′_{n∈ℤ}q_wⁿu/(1−q_wⁿu)²−2s₁，Y(u)=∑′_{n∈ℤ}(q_wⁿu)²/(1−q_wⁿu)³+s₁。这些式子使用全定义的无穷和与域除法；不满足上述避开条件的单位不受这些坐标等式约束。记 U_w(u)=φ_w([u])，L_w(ℓ)={U_w(u):u∈K_wˣ 且 u^ℓ=1}，并以 C_w(ℓ,P) 表示存在单位 u 和整数 m，使 U_w(u)=P，且 u^ℓ=q_w^(1+ℓm) 或 u^ℓ=q_w^(−1+ℓm)。最后这个谓词中的 C_w 记号与变量变换的 C_w 分别使用。 TateFamily 的一个值首先为每个有限位 w 及 Bad(w) 的每个证明 h，利用 K_w 上完备的一秩整数值赋值域结构提供这样的 TateStructure S(w,h)。第二个字段要求：对每个 w、h 及 K 的每个 F-代数自同构 σ，L_{σw}(ℓ) 沿点映射 E_K→E_{σw} 的逆像，等于 L_w(ℓ) 沿 E_K→E_w 的逆像再经 G_σ 所得的像，两者作为 E_K 点群的加法子群相等；目标端的 TateStructure 使用前一引理由 h 得到的 Bad(σw) 证明。第三个字段要求：对每个这样的 w、h、σ 及 E_K 的每个点 R，C_{σw}(ℓ,ι_{σw,*}(G_σR)) 成立当且仅当 C_w(ℓ,ι_{w,*}R) 成立；这里点映射 ι_{w,*} 将完备化嵌入作用于点坐标。第二个条件比较整个逆像子群，第三个条件是双向等价，分别不只是包含或单向蕴含。不另行要求不同位处的值共享参数、变量变换或同构。量词包含 ℓ=0：此时每个单位的零次幂都是 1，所以 L_w(0) 为整个点群，而 C_w(0,P) 要求 1=q_w 或 1=q_w⁻¹，与 ‖q_w‖<1 不相容；ℓ=1 也被允许。如果没有任何 w 满足 Bad(w)，全部三个字段的索引要求均为空或真空成立，VBad 为空时即如此。该结构不声称对任意输入都存在其值。
